title: Dungeon Cartography - Commission No. 5
author: point01iv
rules:
DUNGEON CARTOGRAPHY
New to the series? Start with the earlier commissions:
Commission No. 1: The Cellar
Commission No. 2: The Smugglers' Tunnels
Commission No. 3: The Abandoned Mine
Commission No. 4: The Old Catacombs

Heroes have started asking for you by name, and that has opened doors that were closed to you before. Now that your name carries some credibility, heroes tackling the most dangerous dungeons are more likely to trust their lives (and their coin) with your deductions. Such is the case here - the old border fortress has fallen to monsters, and the realm needs it retaken before they spread. The few survivors of its fall have told you what they can. The heroes going in can’t afford a wrong turn:
Rules are the same as Commission No. 4, with the following changes:
• The grid is now 9x9, with 8 rooms of 8 cells.
Draw every wall to complete the map.
Penpa+ Tips
• Penpa only supports solution checking when walls are drawn in green. Please do this to get your Logic Masters solution code.
• To zoom, use your browser's zoom (Ctrl and + or -) rather than Penpa's Resize button, which moves the artwork.

Play this puzzle online in Penpa+
solutionCode: The code word shown when Penpa+ confirms your solution.
